# NPM Improved v1.6.10 — Mobile Control Center

## Mobile navigation and management

- Replace the desktop-style collapsed sidebar on phones with an accessible slide-out navigation drawer. The menu can be dismissed using its backdrop, a navigation selection, or Escape.
- Display host lists as mobile-friendly cards with labeled values and accessible per-host Actions menus instead of requiring horizontal table scrolling.
- Keep Add buttons visible on Proxy Hosts, Redirection Hosts, Streams, and 404 Hosts, including when a list is empty.
- Make host-edit dialogs vertically scrollable through long forms, with horizontally scrollable editor tabs and reachable Save/Cancel controls.
- Remove premature Save dismissal so an editor stays open if saving fails.
- Improve phone-width header spacing and touch target sizes.

## Compatibility

- UI-only release: existing databases, host records, certificates, Nginx configurations, updater, and API permissions are unchanged.
- Desktop layouts are preserved.
- The optional multi-instance Android management app remains a separate future project and is **not** part of v1.6.10.

## Verification

- PR #79 passed automated frontend tests, lint, production build, Docker image/Compose validation and repository checks.
- Physical phone/touch scrolling should still be verified in deployed environments.

## Updating

- Use **Settings → Update** on supported single-node deployments once v1.6.10 appears.
- For NPMX or shared-database clusters, follow the coordinated update guidance and update the primary before secondaries.
- Keep the existing installation backup and rollback capability available during upgrade.
